scope: Audit of past source and anchor only; no E9.5 expression used
source_selection: Cardiac and 18 associated cell types; atlas annotations can reflect joint atlas processing. They are selection metadata, not learner features.
validation_limits: No independent embryo identity established; sample is not embryo
Three-point E9.5 development is reused, not blind
Earlier three-past-stage folds in this subset support quarter-day and half-day horizons, not a full day
Local calibration is not official E10.5 calibration
Normalization is per-cell 10000 log1p; similar library mass alone does not establish domain alignment
existing_whole_atlas_prepared: private/extended_prepared_02 includes E6.5-E9.5, 1000 cells/stage; may support one-day mechanism checks under a different cohort
